description.text: behind a worn wooden shop counter, his right hand resting flat on the counter top, his left arm relaxed at his side. The shop is small and quiet at the end of the day: narrow shelves of muted goods recede behind him, a few containers and a folded cloth sit at the counter edge, a narrow aisle and a closed door are suggested at the far edge of the frame, and low warm practical light falls from above, catching the grain of the wood, the scuffed edge of the counter, and the soft folds of his dark work shirt. The low light leaves the back of the shop in gentle shadow. A faint haze of dust hangs in the still air. He looks down toward the counter, his shoulders square and his posture settled, then lifts his gaze to the person across from him and speaks the line evenly, with a flat, unhurried delivery; his jaw and mouth move in plain close-mic clarity while the rest of his body stays still. The camera holds a static shot. Faint room tone sits under the delivery, and his attention remains fixed on the listener. No other person enters the frame, and nothing on the counter is moved or picked up.
